choice_prompt:2:1611263001.text: Hello, everyone. I'm Noc, Grand Mentor Esten's chief aide. I'll be handling order at the venue today. Please line up and keep your voices down.

say:3:1611263002:1.text: Of course! I'm the most trusted of all the aides.

say:4:1611263003:1.text: Please don't doubt Grand Mentor Esten. Haven't you heard of his great accomplishments?

say:5:1611263004:1.text: I've been all over the place, but I've never heard of him...
say:5:1611263004:1.source_cn: 我去过很多地方，但从没听过他的名字……

say:6:1611263005:1.text: Hmph. Clearly, you're not well-informed. I'd bet anything that the Grand Mentor could heal these students without even breaking a sweat!

say:8:1611263006:1.text: Grand Mentor Esten is the most renowned psychological expert of our age—a master of healing disorders of the mind!
say:8:1611263006:1.source_cn: 埃斯特大导师，当代最著名的心理学专家，心因性障碍治疗宗师！

say:9:1611263007:1.text: In his book, The Codex of the Mind, he introduced the revolutionary "Mana Triangle" theory. He used it to create a brand-new therapy that restores mana through psychological treatment!

choice_prompt:10:1611263007.text: In his book, The Codex of the Mind, he introduced the revolutionary "Mana Triangle" theory. He used it to create a brand-new therapy that restores mana through psychological treatment!
choice_prompt:10:1611263007.source_cn: 他在讲述心理学问题的《心之魔典》一书中，开创性地提出了魔法世界中的“情绪-生理-魔力”的“魔力三角”理论，更是根据这个理论首创了通过心理治疗恢复魔力的疗法！

say:11:1611263008:1.text: A great mind isn't understood by the common person!
say:11:1611263008:1.source_cn: 伟大的理论岂是普通人能够理解的？

say:12:1611263010:1.text: The point is, do not question him. Trust him. Praise him. Follow him. And you will be rewarded!
say:12:1611263010:1.source_cn: 总而言之，不要质疑埃斯特大导师。相信他，赞美他，追随他...
